diagnostic_assessment:
  policy: diagnostic-fixed-v1
  scope: placement_only; no mastery, progress, learning-path, or regular-worker mutation
  freeze: Course content revision plus lesson/task IDs, task versions, updated_at and targets
  attempt_start: Student must revalidate current Course catalog/task versions because Course has no historical question snapshots
  reservation: Student-safe receipt is durable before Issue succeeds; receipt replay skips Student
  retake: expected_previous_revision equals the latest revision and requires its immutable placement decision; revision 1 legacy ID is retained and later revisions have distinct deterministic IDs
  placement: Student aggregate result only; FOUNDATION|CORE|ADVANCED maps to START_FOUNDATION|START_CORE|START_ADVANCED under diagnostic-placement-route-v1
  bootstrap: Student browser supplies only expected onboarding/versioned retake intent; Planner reads onboarding and resolves an exact rollout-provisioned binding with no fallback
replan:
  input_identity: exact learning_path_id is required at the create boundary and included in the request hash
  state_read: exact student_id plus learning_path_id; selected and primary projections are ignored
  desired_route: Course identity, fingerprint, PLANNED or READY items, and policy reason; Student owns monotonic progress reconciliation
  unchanged_course_and_fingerprint: Student semantic no-op keeps path and journey versions stable
  no_gap_matching_current_goal: complete remaining items idempotently on only the exact path
  command_checkpoint: immutable REPLAN or NO_GAP kind, exact Student/path/request identities, expected path version, normalized body, semantic SHA-256, and private planned outcome are committed under the active claim before PUT
  retry_after_ambiguous_delivery: dispatch the stored checkpoint directly with the same planning_request_id and Idempotency-Key; graph, mastery, Course, and Student planning state are not reread
  delivered_conflict: Student 409 is terminal LEARNING_PATH_COMMAND_CONFLICT and is not retried
  result_visibility: result_code, course_id, and reused remain unset until Student success is confirmed and are copied from the private checkpoint only for Complete
  retention: checkpoint survives retry, COMPLETED, and FAILED for bounded operational audit and is never placed in the public response or outbox payload
initial:

  checkpoint: returned learning_path_id is persisted before any later mutation or terminal result
  retry: a pinned INITIAL replays original create body and request key, verifying the resolved ID; legacy ungenerated resolved jobs retain exact-path reconciliation

course_planning_checkpoints:
  port: PinnedCoursePlanRepository on existing CoursePlanRepository
  input: planner-planning-input.v1; immutable first normalized profile/mastery/graph/policy and original path/diagnostic fences plus deterministic draft/context/gap and private request binding
  artifact: planner-generated-course.v1; complete typed Course bound to input_hash before Course ensure
  ensure: planner-course-ensure.v1; ordered Course lesson/revision receipt bound to input_hash and artifact_hash before Student effects
  persistence: private immutable byte-preserving payload plus SHA; active worker claim/lease and stored request identity required
  retry: original checkpoints and deterministic generation/ensure keys; no refreshed learner context or fingerprint
  initial_nil_path: later resolved allocation ID never converts pinned INITIAL into REPLAN; replay original create body/key and verify allocation identity
  legacy_resolved_ungenerated_initial: first pin may retain exact resolved path snapshot with no caller path binding
  legacy_generated_unbound: fail closed LEGACY_GENERATED_COURSE_UNBOUND; no guessing or backfill
  compatibility: existing exact-path command and diagnostic initial-allocation checkpoints dispatch first; valid optional pins restore original fingerprint/context audit; absent legacy pins remain replayable; completed jobs remain historical
  application_fences: original exact-path ExpectedVersion and diagnostic onboarding/direction; no new global mastery or generic INITIAL policy
  public_contract: unchanged; private input_hash is distinct from unchanged student-neutral course-fingerprint-v1

hybrid_replanning_v1:
  policy_version: hybrid-replan-v1
  policy_owner: Learning Planner
  input: one coherent Student snapshot plus first pinned existing PolicyBundle and bounded published prerequisite graph
  threshold: existing PolicyBundle.MasterySkipConfidence; current default 0.80
  objective_quality: [OBSERVATION, ASSESSMENT, EXECUTION, PROJECT, UNKNOWN]
  positive: all targets MASTERED and accepted confidence and EXECUTION_or_PROJECT and STABLE; future PLANNED redundant work only
  stability: current Student independent_application kind; at least three independent applications across at least two task identities and MASTERED
  protected: [READY, IN_PROGRESS, COMPLETED, SKIPPED_MASTERED, RESERVED_OR_OPEN_PRACTICE_BINDING]
  negative: existing deterministic prerequisite gaps can only reorder already-frozen future slots; no new failure heuristic or generated material
  intent: optional one exact learner-owned pending projection bound into snapshot ref; absent projection preserves earlier snapshot hashes
  consent: proposed REQUIRES_INTENT does not consume or consent; Student validates actor, exact scope, revision and ordinary boundary later
  unavailable_track: fail closed; no invented track identity
  outcomes: [NO_CHANGE, REPLAN_NEEDED]
  provenance: consequence_id, student, path, expected_path_revision, snapshot_ref, policy_version, policy_input_hash, exact_snapshot_targets, baseline_and_desired_scope, reason_codes, typed_future_mutations
  mutation: evaluator and consequence worker have no Student application or Runtime port
  determinism: one semantic consequence per snapshot and Hybrid policy; capture and trigger trace are excluded
